blurb: My roots run deep. Africa is ingrained in my DNA thanks to my Huguenot ancestors who arrived in 1688. This is the only explanation I can muster for the irrational and all-consuming passion I have felt all my life for the continent of my birth. From its primordial landscapes, ancient wilderness areas and abundant wildlife to the indigenous knowledge and ingenuity of its peoples, Africa has been my biggest inspiration
